subject: science
passage: Many Sherpa people live in the high valleys of Nepal near Mount Everest, where the air holds far less oxygen than it does at sea level. Studies suggest that the bodies of many Sherpas use oxygen very ______ can often work hard in thin air that would quickly exhaust visitors from lower places.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "The bodies of many Sherpas use oxygen very efficiently" and "they can often work hard in thin air" are both independent clauses. A comma followed by the conjunction "so" correctly joins them and shows cause and effect.
explanation.A: Correct. A comma plus "so" correctly joins the two independent clauses.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.C: Incorrect. When "so" joins two independent clauses, the comma goes before "so," not after it.
explanation.D: Incorrect. With no punctuation or conjunction, the two independent clauses run together (a run-on sentence).
